title: IN WHICH PASSEPARTOUT IS CONVINCED THAT HE HAS AT LAST FOUND HIS IDEAL
summary_hover: Left alone in the house at Saville Row, Passepartout explores his new quarters and happily embraces the strict, orderly routine required by his master.
summary_detail: Passepartout reflects on his new employer, Phileas Fogg, comparing the gentleman's extreme composure to a precise machine or a wax figure. Upon exploring the mansion at Saville Row, Passepartout is delighted by its comfort and the meticulous daily schedule laid out for him. After serving unpredictable masters in the past, he feels he has finally found the tranquil, predictable domestic life he desires.
